name: Review — Photoshop-style photo printing
target: macOS Preview; Adobe Photoshop 2025 Print Settings

target_description.en: Preview views and annotates images and PDFs; Photoshop edits photos and controls their printed size, placement and color.
target_description.zh-CN: Preview 用于查看和标注图片、PDF；Photoshop 用于修图，并设置照片打印的尺寸、位置与色彩。

summary.en: Preview-style Rust viewer with a Photoshop-inspired photo-print dialog supporting placement, proportional sizing, PPI display, crop marks and PDF output.
summary.zh-CN: 参考 Preview 的 Rust 查看器，另实现受 Photoshop 启发的照片打印对话框，支持定位、等比尺寸、PPI 显示、裁切标记和 PDF 输出。

rea.en: REA 6.4 inspect-macho identified Photoshop's imported printing APIs, combined with shipped layout resources and strings to inform an independent implementation.
rea.zh-CN: REA 6.4 inspect-macho 识别 Photoshop 导入的打印 API，结合发行版布局资源和字符串指导独立实现。

limitations.en: The Adobe-related work covers one print workflow, omits several print options, and neither decompiles Adobe code nor reconstructs Photoshop as a whole.
limitations.zh-CN: Adobe 相关工作仅覆盖一条打印流程，仍缺多项打印设置，既未反编译 Adobe 代码，也未重建完整 Photoshop。
